# gsa1_090_rings.md 4.1). Numbers and names only (no game data). The ids are libsa1's own and stable: they are NOT a stage's
# object-list index (RING is index 0 everywhere, O_GRING 21 / 1 / 104 ..., O_ITEMBOX 13 / 15 / 27 ...); 1.0's generator must
# keep them. src/sa1_set.c holds the same table (tests/set_test.c compares the two).
# columns: id, list name, exec, im, level, attribute, range (0 = the spawner 8C091380's 400-unit default), class, model,
# rotation order (none / y / zxy: the njRotate order of the type's code), states, budget
